procedure: Treat roughly 50 or more media objects, many sections, grouped/floating drawings, or text-bearing shapes as an image-heavy Word workload.
Inventory pictures, floating/grouped drawings, text-bearing shapes, zero-display hyperlinks, and private-use glyph fonts before processing.
Run process and verify as separate persistent background jobs with an explicit execution limit; monitor only the owned Word process and always close documents and quit Word in finally.
Fit pictures to the text width, preserve aspect ratio, center them, retain approved unsupported drawings, and never discard text-bearing shapes.
Do not trust text-box AutoSize or floating coordinates without a Word-native render; make source-specific coordinate corrections only in the generated output and keep shape text unchanged.
Remove only hyperlinks with empty display text because Word can materialize invisible URL destinations during copy or field refresh.
Restore known private-use Symbol or Wingdings run fonts after canonical body-font formatting so preserved glyph characters do not render as replacement boxes.
Require exact protected-word verification, render every page with Word, inspect every page, and rerender/reinspect changed pages after any output-only layout correction.
rollback: Keep this record as a candidate until another image-heavy DOCX confirms the workflow.
Remove the candidate and revert the image-heavy section in skills.md if later evidence contradicts it.
